opportunity: Problem-aware searchers who are already spending on Google Ads but seeing clicks with no revenue. Pain is acute and real. Article must be honest: some problems are campaign-side, most are page-side. The differentiation between campaign and page problems is the primary diagnostic value. Bridge to free audit for page diagnosis.

evidence_sources.description: 892 completed audits. Ad signal alignment is the second most common finding at 19.9% of all issues, severity 3.6. This directly maps to Google Ads traffic that clicks but does not convert due to post-click message mismatch.
Median Google Ads CVR 3.75%, top 25% above 5.31%. Search network median by industry varies 2-6%.
53% of mobile visits abandoned when load time exceeds 3 seconds.

angle: Separate the diagnosis into two branches: campaign-side problems (keywords, bidding, audience, match type) vs. page-side problems (message match, above-fold layout, trust signals, speed). Most guides conflate them. The article establishes that in Nebula's audit data, page-side problems dominate when founders describe this symptom, but does not dismiss campaign-side issues. Covers how to tell which branch is the actual cause using observable signals.
